quests.title: Island Cave (Four Island): Crystal Onix and Granny Lisa

acquisitions.place: Four Island, Island Cave — hidden Crystal Onix chamber
acquisitions.conditions: Crystal Onix (form 1): first speak to the Four Island stone craftsman, then defeat Granny Lisa in the hidden cave. Agree to keep her secret, speak to her again, then talk to Onix. Refusing the secret permanently loses this encounter. One chance even if you lose.
